2608.28405.title: CultureConverse: A Multilingual Multi-turn Simulation Harness for Culturally Grounded Assistance in East and Southeast Asia
2608.28405.paper_summary: Current cultural evaluations for large language models (LLMs) often reduce culture to single-turn factual recall via MCQs, failing to capture a common use case: users seeking practical help over multiple turns in culturally grounded scenarios. We introduce CultureConverse, a scalable, multilingual simulation and evaluation harness for culturally grounded assistant dialogue that covers 10 East and Southeast Asian regions, 58 subgroup identities, and 7 domains. Each simulated and evaluated episode produces a scored interaction where the assistant assists the user and infers cultural constraints from partial information. The resulting CultureConverse-DS dataset contains 14,610 benchmark (evaluation) episodes and 274,295 oracle-guided (gold-mode) dialogues. In our benchmark evaluation of 18 models, GPT-5 mini achieves the highest assistance quality. Human annotation experiments suggest that our evaluation framework is a sufficient proxy for human judgment. Performance gains from fine-tuning on 27,860 high-quality CultureConverse-DS samples improve in-domain assistance and transfer out-of-domain to cultural MCQ and safety classification benchmarks. We release the harness, both splits, and judge prompts to support interactive evaluation of cultural competency.
2608.28405.paper_summary_zh: 目前對大型語言模型（LLMs）的文化評估通常將文化簡化為單回合的事實回憶，通過多選題（MCQs）進行，未能捕捉到一個常見的使用案例：用戶在文化背景情境中尋求多回合的實際幫助。我們引入了CultureConverse，一個可擴展的多語言模擬和評估工具，專為文化背景助手對話而設，涵蓋了10個東亞和東南亞地區、58個子群體身份以及7個領域。每個模擬和評估的事件都會產生一個得分互動，其中助手協助用戶並從部分信息中推斷文化限制。最終生成的CultureConverse-DS數據集包含14,610個基準（評估）事件和274,295個由神諭引導（黃金模式）對話。在我們對18個模型的基準評估中，GPT-5 mini達到了最高的協助質量。人類標註實驗表明，我們的評估框架是人類判斷的充分代理。對27,860個高質量CultureConverse-DS樣本進行微調所帶來的性能提升改善了領域內的協助，並能轉移到文化多選題和安全分類基準的領域外。我們發布了這個工具、兩個數據集的分割以及評估提示，以支持文化能力的互動評估。
